Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (RAP-MS) specifically compares proteins interacting with NEAT1 (N1_5' probes) versus a control (Ctrl probes) across three conditions: untreated (DMSO), Nutlin-3a treated, and HU treated. While genetic perturbations (shRNA/siRNA) are discussed in the text, the MS data described in the PRIDE metadata and results section focus on the RAP-MS interaction screen under chemical stress.
